observations: The three gleaned item heads and the one-by-one fallen-grain interpretation are explicit.
Puṣpā and the sūtra have uñch; the SanskritDocuments Kāśikā body prints ucch. Nyāsa gives an uddhunoti paraphrase.
Both uchi gaṇa addresses are positively indexed. The explicit num witness gives the nasal present.
The uchī vivāse homonym has different marker and sense. Rakṣ pālane has its own address.
The assembly in samājaṃ is the protected object. Kāśikā here prints the anusvāra sāṃniveśikaḥ.
Tattva defines the gathering. Śabdakalpadruma and Kāśikā 7.3.60 give sam + aj + ghañ and lexical j retention.
Śabda and dardura are separate lexical objects, and the donkey sound case is overtly outside the intended role.
Tattva supplies the percussion-object sense. Vācaspatyam gives a separate earthenware craft with ṭhañ.
The next-rule paragraph containing the matsya/related group occurs as a displaced second Tattva paragraph on the page.
Plural samavāyān widens the named semantic class, and Kāśikā prints four examples including double-n sānniveśikaḥ.
Nyāsa supplies the collective versus mental consultation contrast and mere arrival. Tattva supplies the ordinary locative.
Sam + ava + iṇ and the strong sārvadhātuka versus kit kta contrast license two different sound seams.
The Naṭa's separately printed sāmājikān has direct audience semantics and independent case evidence.
Exact pariṣad override is ṇya with the inherited membership frame.
Senā keeps both ṇya and default ṭhak on the same membership request.

Choose only the documented protected object in 4.4.33. The distinct threat role stays an inherited case control.
Keep lexical ghañ of samāja distinct from the outer ṭhak. Preserve the original j and the selected supplied collective sense.
Admit analytical word knowledge and the percussion-object maker. Retain the earthenware craft analysis in a named competing record.
Keep the displaced second Tattva paragraph outside the attachment for 4.4.34. It needs its own 4.4.35 source handling.
Membership covers the four named assembly bases. Mere entry, mental consultation, and mere protection fail that role. Carry both acc and actual locative at their respective supports.
Retain the two nasalized displays at their exact source addresses. The audience masculine accusative plural attaches only to the join/member family.
Apply mandatory ṇya only to the council member branch.
Apply both optional ṇya and ṭhak only to the same army-member input, with no inherited ṭhan from 4.4.42.
